result.summary: Found 3 issues: active Pizza filter does not match displayed restaurants, truncated restaurant name in carousel, and low-contrast secondary text.

issues.description: Category chip 'Pizza' is visually selected/active but the lists below show non-pizza venues: Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria and Tokumaru Ramen Bar
issues.suggestion: Sync displayed results with the active filter, or reset filter to 'All' when showing mixed cuisines

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' row shows restaurant name clipped mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' at screen edge without ellipsis handling
issues.suggestion: Ensure card text truncates with ellipsis inside card bounds and add end padding for horizontal scroll list

issues.description: Search placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' and secondary delivery fee text have low contrast on light grey background
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary and placeholder text to meet WCAG contrast ratios
